verdict.rationale: Conductor gives developers a chat-driven front end to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode agents. Those agents can test repositories and run builds, and failing-check logs surface in workspaces, so natural-language troubleshooting is implied. Nothing in the evidence explicitly documents a debugging or troubleshooting workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language debugging or troubleshooting, examples of diagnosing errors from logs or stack traces, independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.
Create workspaces, send prompts to the coding agent, and read its replies.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds
PR comments and failing-check logs now load while a cloud workspace is asleep.
